title: Monotonicity conjecture for the convergence-rate quotients of the canonical iterates
statement:
The sequence $(\kappa_n)_{n\in\mathbb N_0}$ provides approximations to the stribolic constant $\kappa$. Define the convergence-rate quotients by

$$
\vartheta_n:=\frac{\kappa_n-\kappa_{n+1}}{\kappa_{n-1}-\kappa_n},\qquad n\in\mathbb N.
$$

**Monotonicity conjecture.** For all $m\in\mathbb N$, one has

$$
\vartheta_{2m}<\vartheta_{2m+2}<\vartheta_{2m+3}<\vartheta_{2m+1}.
$$

The inequalities are suggested by the computed values for $2\leq n\leq22$ and would provide sharper estimates for $\kappa$ through iterated extrapolation.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.06618

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of February 2024).
source_name: Roland Miyamoto, “Polynomial parametrisation of the canonical iterates to the solution of -γg'= g^-1”, arXiv:2402.06618 (2024).
